8: "We collect from him the keren only" — but not what is in excess of the keren, such as the shevach (appreciation in value) and [the increase] before yi'ush (despair) that we collect from the gazlan — these are not collected in Bavel. So wrote the Bach. But in my humble opinion, we do collect the shevach also, and [the Mechaber] only comes to exclude the kenas of the gazlan. And this is what the Rambam wrote at the beginning: "dinei kenasos, such as gezeilos and chavalos, etc., we do not judge, etc." And one should not raise a difficulty: but he wrote "such as gezeilos and chavalos and tashlumei kefel daled v'hei" — implying that "gezeilos" is not referring to the tashlumei daled v'hei, since if it were, why need he say "tashlumei daled v'hei" again? The answer is: at the beginning he wrote the kenas of gezeilos — such as when he stole or robbed from his fellow's house in a manner that obligates kefel daled v'hei — and afterwards he wrote tashlumei daled v'hei without qualification, meaning, for example, when he claims the claim of a thief regarding a deposit and swears [falsely], and similar cases.
